title: Tracing a customer incident with AI, safely
problem: Finding the cause of a customer incident from large amounts of logs and configuration data typically took about a day, and that data can't just be pasted into an AI tool.
approach: I wrote a script to redact sensitive data first, then used Claude and Rovo to analyse and cross-check what remained.
result: The incident was traced in 30 minutes instead of about a day. The same approach has helped produce around 30 runbooks and SOPs since late 2024.
lesson: Redact before you prompt. The speed-up only matters if the data was safe to use.
